title: Warranty Coverage — Schedule of Component Coverage Terms by Plan
content:
Under Warranty Coverage, each Ridgeline plan covers the parts of a window or door for a set term, counted in years from the coverage start date, and some terms run for a lifetime. This schedule states every term for all six plans.

## What each term covers

- **Frames and sashes** — defects in material and workmanship of frames and sashes.
- **Insulated glass** — seal failure of the insulated glass unit.
- **Hardware** — locks, handles, balances and operators.
- **Screens** — screens and screen frames.
- **Weatherstripping** — the weatherstrip on the unit.
- **Exterior finish** — exterior color finish against peeling, blistering and fading beyond the published color-change limit.
- **Labor** — the term during which Ridgeline labor to repair or replace a covered part is included.
- **Workmanship** — installation workmanship: leaks, sealing, trim and fastening by the Ridgeline crew.

## Schedule (years from the coverage start date)

| Plan | Frames & sashes | Insulated glass | Hardware | Screens | Weatherstrip | Exterior finish | Labor | Workmanship |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 20 | 10 | 5 | 1 | 2 | 5 | 1 | 1 |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 20 | 20 | 10 | 2 | 5 | 10 | 2 | 2 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | lifetime | 20 | 10 | 5 | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | lifetime | lifetime | 20 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | lifetime | lifetime | lifetime | 10 | 20 | 15 | lifetime | 10 |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | lifetime | lifetime | lifetime | 10 | 20 | 20 | lifetime | lifetime |

## Meaning of "lifetime"

In every plan, a lifetime term runs **for as long as the registered owner owns the home at the service address**.

## Reading the schedule

- The labor term and the component term are separate columns: a part can still be covered after the labor term for that plan has run out.
- Workmanship is its own column and has its own term, which is not the same as the term of any part.
- Under the Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty, frames and sashes are lifetime while insulated glass is 20 years; under the Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty both are lifetime.

## Points of reference

**Which plans include Ridgeline labor for life?** The Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty and the Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty. Under every other plan the labor term is a number of years: 1, 2, 5 or 10 according to the table.

**Which plan has the longest screen term?** Screens are 10 years under the Ridgeline Lifetime Plus, Lifetime Premier and Owner-to-Owner Lifetime plans, and shorter under the other three.
